2608.27046.title: Performance Foundations of Parallel & Distributed Reasoning Language Models
2608.27046.paper_summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) and other RL-style post-training paradigms have been used for aligning large language models (LLMs) with reasoning standards. The resulting recent Reasoning Language Models (RLMs) such as DeepSeek-R1, o3, and Kimi k1.5 show that such RL-style post-training ("RL-for-LLMs") can substantially improve chain-of-thought reasoning, long-horizon planning, and self-correction. However, the computational footprint of these systems is massive: state-of-the-art RLM training requires millions of GPU-hours and tightly coupled multi-model pipelines that stress modern hardware far beyond classical supervised LLM training. This makes RLM training as much a parallel and distributed systems problem as an algorithmic one. In this work, to facilitate developing RLMs that are simultaneously high-performance, scalable, and cost-effective, we first systematize the RL-for-LLM paradigm and provide a compute-centric analysis of prominent post-training algorithmic frameworks: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), as well as their variants. Second, we develop a taxonomy of intra- and inter-model parallelism strategies for RL-for-LLMs, covering both traditional techniques (data, tensor, pipeline, sequence, context, and expert parallelism) as well as novel forms of parallelism and optimization techniques for multi-model RLM training, for example disaggregated placement, stage fusion, hybrid parallelism, and asynchronous execution. We harness the work-depth model of parallel computing to make our taxonomy and its insights rigorous and portable. Finally, we analyze existing RLM frameworks and we distill practical guidelines and outline open research directions for building scalable, fast, and cost-effective RLMs.
2608.27046.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習與可驗證獎勵（RLVR）及其他強化學習風格的後訓練範式已被用於使大型語言模型（LLMs）符合推理標準。最近的推理語言模型（RLMs），如DeepSeek-R1、o3和Kimi k1.5，顯示這種強化學習風格的後訓練（“RL-for-LLMs”）可以顯著改善思考鏈推理、長期規劃和自我修正。然而，這些系統的計算足跡龐大：最先進的RLM訓練需要數百萬的GPU小時和緊密耦合的多模型管道，這對現代硬體的壓力遠超過傳統的監督式LLM訓練。這使得RLM訓練既是一個並行和分佈式系統問題，也是一個算法問題。在這項工作中，為了促進開發同時具備高性能、可擴展性和成本效益的RLM，我們首先系統化了RL-for-LLM範式，並提供了一個以計算為中心的分析，涵蓋了顯著的後訓練算法框架：近端策略優化（PPO）、群體相對策略優化（GRPO）及其變體。其次，我們為RL-for-LLMs開發了一個內部和外部模型並行策略的分類法，涵蓋了傳統技術（數據、張量、管道、序列、上下文和專家並行）以及針對多模型RLM訓練的新型並行性和優化技術，例如分散式放置、階段融合、混合並行和異步執行。我們利用並行計算的工作深度模型，使我們的分類法及其見解變得嚴謹且可移植。最後，我們分析了現有的RLM框架，提煉出實用的指導方針，並概述了構建可擴展、快速且具成本效益的RLM的開放研究方向。
